name: Coffee
description: Restores 20 Uptime. Office brew, still somehow warm.

name: Energy Drink
description: Restores 60 Uptime. Not recommended after 4 PM.

name: Pizza Friday
description: Fully restores Uptime and cures any status. Morale +100.

name: Hard Reboot
description: Revives a crashed Forgeling with half its Uptime. Off, then on.

name: Firewall Rule
description: For 100 steps, wild Forgelings weaker than your lead stay away.

name: Ctrl+Z
description: Use in a dungeon to warp straight back to its entrance.

name: Thumb Drive
description: Quarantine Key: use in battle to catch a wild Forgeling. Basic odds.

name: Encrypted Key
description: Quarantine Key with better odds (x1.5) of catching a wild Forgeling.

name: Hardware Token
description: Quarantine Key with high odds (x2) of catching a wild Forgeling.

name: Root Key
description: Full admin access. Quarantines any Forgeling, guaranteed.

name: Overclock Chip
description: Raises one Forgeling's level by 1. It may learn a move or upgrade.

name: Legacy Driver
description: Upgrades certain Legacy Forgelings. A driver for long-gone hardware.
